scores.notes: Alice holds a flamingo and glances toward the Queen at right with the Cheshire Cat's head between them; card courtiers carry corner index glyphs (e.g. a numeral-like mark at the top-left and bottom-right of the right-hand card and the arch cards).
Four Roman soldiers crouch casting dice before the cross on a rocky hill; the titulus plaque at the top of the cross bears faint dark glyph-like marks.
Alice in the foreground with the Queen close behind and the grinning Cat's head floating at centre on the croquet lawn; a painted signature-like scrawl sits in the bottom-right corner.
Alice holds up the bottle in a long panelled hall with lamps, a glass table with key and a small open door; the bottle's paper label carries three lines of pseudo-script.
The White Rabbit in spectacles reads a scroll at a stand before the King and Queen, Alice and the animal jury; loose papers on the floor (bottom centre-left and right) show handwriting-like lines.
Daniel stands at left with hands raised facing seated Belshazzar, a glowing hand on a blank plastered wall between them; walls, rugs, tables and corners show only ornament, no writing.

Alice holds a flamingo at left, card soldiers form arches and the crimson Queen shouts mid-ground; the right-hand hedge carries letter-like squiggles (D/q/p shapes) and some card corners show small index-like marks.
A row of carved stone markers recedes along a village road with villagers and a Roman soldier; the large foreground stele and the next stones bear carved inscriptions of letter-like characters.

The Hatter bites his teacup holding bread before the bench while the Queen peers through spectacles beside the King; papers on the floor (bottom left and centre right) carry lines of text-like scribble.
Paul holds a bronze mirror in a colonnaded courtyard with believers behind and an oil lamp on a ledge; scrolls at his belt and on the table at bottom right are closed and blank, corners clean.
Alice raises a bottle in a long lamp-lit hall with a glass table, key and small locked door; the bottle label is blank and no marks appear on walls, floor or corners.
Daniel gestures at left toward seated Belshazzar with a radiant hand by the glazed lion wall; frieze and furniture carry only geometric/scroll ornament, no inscription.

Alice stands defiant before the dais where the King holds a notebook and the Queen leans in, jury box behind; floor papers at right show faint text lines and card courtiers have small corner index marks.

Alice faces the high dais where the King holds a notepad and the Queen leans toward him with the animal jury at right; card soldiers at left show numeral-like corner indices and floor papers carry lines of script.
Daniel raises a hand toward seated Belshazzar while a glowing hand writes on the blue brick wall; a row of glyph-like characters is visible on the wall beside the hand.
Alice laughs holding a flamingo at left while the Queen stamps forward shouting at right with card arches between; a signature-like scrawl sits at the bottom-left corner.
Daniel stands with hands raised before seated Belshazzar with a soft glow on the back wall between them; no hand or writing visible, and walls, rugs and corners show only ornament.
Golden light pours through an open city gate across a square of townsfolk with raised arms, stalls, jars and chests; no lettering found on walls, chests or corners.

Weathered stone markers line a village road with the largest at left foreground, villagers and a Roman soldier by a limestone wall; the large stone's panel and the next marker show faint carved glyph-like marks.
Four Roman soldiers crouch over pebbles/dice with garments on the ground below the distant cross; the titulus is blank and the shield, rocks and corners carry no marks.

The White Rabbit in spectacles reads a scroll at a stand before the King and Queen with Alice and the animal jury; the scroll, floor papers, slates and the queen card on the wall show no legible or pseudo-script marks.
Paul gazes into a bronze mirror at centre with believers around him in a colonnaded courtyard, oil lamp and rolled scrolls on the ledge at right; scrolls are closed and unmarked.
Radiant light floods through the open city gate into a paved square where townsfolk and children raise their arms, with jars and a chest at left; the hillside monument and walls are plain.
